desc_en: The Perle IOLAN SCG48 M is a 48-port secure console server delivering enterprise-grade out-of-band management, featuring software-selectable RS-232/422/485 multi-protocol RJ45 serial ports, dual Gigabit RJ45 + dual SFP fiber uplinks, and dual redundant AC power supplies within a compact 1U chassis.

advantages_en: 48-Port Extreme Density: Concentrates 48 software-configurable serial ports in 1U to manage full multi-rack network fabrics.

1+1 Dual Redundant AC Supplies: Dual isolated power feeds guarantee zero downtime with front-panel P1/P2 status LEDs.
